NoSQLServer v0.55 validation
============================
Federated catalog milestone.

Delivered
---------
- One FederatedDatabaseEngine exposes FILE and OBJECT tables in one catalog view.
- FILE JOIN OBJECT executes as ordinary SQL over table readRows ports.
- Object tables retain live getter/setter semantics.
- File tables retain existing persistent storage, indexes, journals, tombstones and planner behaviour.
- Object/federated engines do not advertise TRANSACTIONS/SAVEPOINTS/PREPARED transaction capabilities.
- db~transaction on object/federated engines returns a clean SQLUNSUPPORTED transaction object.
- msqlshim is untouched.

Isolation invariant
-------------------
NoSQLServerSQL contains zero references to:
  ~storage, SysFile*, CsvStream, .Yaml, ~path, table.yaml, /tables/

Acceptance
----------
- v0.55 FILE-object join smoke: PASS
- v0.54 object UPDATE/event smoke: PASS
- v0.53 object join/aggregate smoke: PASS
- v0.52 object SELECT smoke: PASS
- all historical file feature gates: PASS
- Claude torture: 12/12 PASS
- Grok hell v1: 24/25 PASS, WRONG_RESULT 0
- Grok hell v2: 14/30 PASS, WRONG_RESULT 0
- ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 compile checks: PASS
